text:
Maya (AE): Kicking off CedarBridge pilot thread. Need to agree on priority use cases, success criteria, and any legal/security blockers by next Wed. Theyre focused on prior-auth automation, eligibility checks, and clinician follow-ups.
Ethan (SE): noted. can we enumerate endpoints so I can size throughput and caching needs?
Maya (AE): top ask from their product: 1) eligibility-check endpoint (low token, high QPS), 2) prior-auth form autofill (structured JSON output, high accuracy), 3) clinician follow-up suggestions (conversation + templated actions).
Carlos (PM): propose mapping: 
- POST /v1/eligibility -> sync fast path, short context cache
- POST /v1/autofill/pa -> structured output, must preserve field ordering
- POST /v1/followup -> streaming suggestions, include action buttons payload

Ethan (SE): sample autofill payload for token estimate: ```json
{
  "claim_id":"CB-9981",
  "form_fields":[{"label":"ICD10","text":"H54.7"},{"label":"Procedure","text":"Knee arthroscopy"}],
  "output_schema":{"patient":{},"codes":[],"instructions":"string"}
}```
Lina (Security): CedarBridge requires BAA + proof of encrypted-in-transit and encrypted-at-rest. They also want KMS integration with customer-managed keys and an options doc for data residency.
Maya (AE): procurement asked about pilot scale: 50 clinicians, ~60k tokens/day. Also curious about cost delta between hosted + private networking vs Dedicated.
Ethan (SE): rough math: 60k tokens/day ~1.8M/mo. Hosted is simplest; Dedicated gives predictable throughput and private network endpoint. I'll draft two cost buckets and conservative latency projections.
Carlos (PM): success criteria suggestions:
- Eligibility: p95 latency <200ms, false negative rate <1.5% on eval set
- Autofill: field-level accuracy >=95%, output schema conformance 99.5%
- Followup: clinicians accept suggestion rate >=40% and average edit distance <=0.25 vs gold
And operational: deployable inside CedarBridge VPC or Dedicated with audit logs for 180 days.
Lina (Security): additional asks: no long-term retention of raw EHR extracts on our hosted storage, tamper-evident audit logs, RBAC for route keys, and an incident response contact. Also need a redaction spec for SSNs and full MRNs.
Maya (AE): CedarBridge legal will send a redaction sample and a security questionnaire. DeployBot: security questionnaire uploaded: https://files.company/cedarbridge_security_q2.pdf
Ethan (SE): infra notes: enable prefix caching on eligibility route, batch summarization for autofill to amortize cost, and streaming for followup suggestions to improve perceived latency. Recommend canary rollout at 5% then 25% then 100%.
Carlos (PM): evaluation plan: we need 100 eligibility queries (real/anon), 150 gold autofill forms, and 80 clinician followup sessions recorded for offline metrics. Can engineering spin up a synthetic generator to create edge-case ICD mappings?
Ethan (SE): yes, we can add a generator. I'll produce a 150-sample autofill set + an eligible/uneligible split for the eligibility eval.
Maya (AE): timeline proposal: Week 1: security & legal signoff + infra sketch, Week 2: internal evals + tuning, Week 3: pilot alpha (5 users), Week 4-5: expand to 50 users and collect metrics.
Carlos (PM): blockers: signed BAA, KMS key exchange and IP allowlist from CedarBridge, final redaction list. CedarBridge committed to provide redaction list by Tue next week.
Lina (Security): action items for security: I will draft the KMS integration doc and redaction spec (owner: Lina, due Tue).
Ethan (SE): action items for infra: cost options and latency projections + synthetic eval harness (owner: Ethan, due Mon).
Carlos (PM): action: success metrics doc + rollout plan (owner: Carlos, due Wed).
Maya (AE): I'll follow up with CedarBridge procurement/legal and consolidate their deliverables (owner: Maya, due Mon).
DeployBot: ticket created: https://tracker/issue/CB-POC-2211 (automated)
Maya (AE): quick question for SEs  can we set auto-fallback to a quantized model if p99 >900ms and still preserve field ordering for autofill?
Ethan (SE): yes, fallback to quantized variant allowed, but well enforce strict schema validation post-inference and re-run light normalization if ordering deviates. Will include this in the rollout config.
Lina (Security): monitoring: need immutable audit stream to their SIEM, alerts on suspected PHI leakage, and weekly retention export to their S3.
Carlos (PM): agreed. add token-level billing dashboard and per-route SLO alerts (>15% regression) to Console.
Maya (AE): great. I'll send a summary to CedarBridge after this thread. Thanks team :rocket:
Ethan (SE): ack.
Lina (Security): ack.
Carlos (PM): ack.
